item.title: Uber Buys Parking App SpotHero to Grow Its Customer Base
item.description: Uber Technologies Inc. is buying parking reservation app SpotHero Inc., the latest move by the rideshare company to expand its customer base.

item.title: Oil Edges Higher as Traders Assess Outlook for Iran Nuclear Deal
item.description: Oil rose as investors weighed the odds of an Iranian nuclear deal, with US President Donald Trump saying he prefers a diplomatic solution but warned of consequences if an agreement wasn’t reached.

item.title: China Presses Takaichi With Hardened Export Curbs on Japan Firms
item.description: China blacklisted 20 Japanese entities and tightened scrutiny on a raft of other firms, signaling Beijing’s pressure campaign on Tokyo isn’t slowing even after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s recent landslide victory.

item.title: Copper Jumps as China Traders Cheer Prospect of Lower US Levies
item.description: Base metals gained as China’s markets reopened after the Lunar New Year break and traders cheered potentially lower US tariffs.

item.title: Trump Seeks Vows from Tech Executives to Cover Data Center Costs
item.description: White House officials are asking technology companies to pledge that their data centers won’t increase electricity prices and cause other burdens for consumers, according to two people familiar with the initiative.

item.title: Trump’s 10% Levy Takes Effect as US Rebuilds Tariff Wall
item.description: Donald Trump’s new 10% global tariffs went into effect on Tuesday, kicking off a White House effort to preserve the president’s trade agenda after the Supreme Court struck down his original sweeping duties.

item.title: Four Years Into Putin’s War, the Ukraine Peace Push Is Stalling
item.description: President Donald Trump’s efforts to end Russia’s invasion of Ukraine are stalling with peace talks deadlocked and the fighting largely at a stalemate after four years of war.

item.title: Air France, Accor to Pay Bond Penalty for Missing Climate Goals
item.description: Air France-KLM and hotelier Accor SA will need to cough up financial penalties to bondholders because they failed to meet greenhouse gas targets.

item.title: LNG Glut May Pressure Prices But Demand Is Strong, Woodside Says
item.description: A forecast global glut of liquefied natural gas may weigh on prices, but demand growth is strong and supply additions aren’t certain, according to Australia’s biggest LNG producer.
